# Straight Line Roofing & Siding Inc.

> > Professional roofing, siding, window, and exterior remodeling contractor serving Central and Southern Maine since 1989.

Straight Line Roofing & Siding Inc. is an Owens Corning preferred contractor offering comprehensive exterior home improvement services throughout Bangor, Lewiston, Auburn, and Turner, Maine. The company specializes in residential roofing installation and repair, vinyl and cedar siding, energy-efficient windows, custom decks, and complete exterior remodeling with lifetime warranties.

## Key Topics

- Roofing installation and repair
- Siding installation (vinyl, cedar, engineered wood)
- Window installation and replacement
- Exterior remodeling services
- Central Maine and Southern Maine service areas
- Bangor, Lewiston, Auburn, Turner locations
- Owens Corning preferred contractor
- Energy efficiency improvements
- Custom deck construction
- Door installation (Therma-Tru)
- Asphalt shingle and metal roofing
- Free estimates and lifetime warranties
- Home maintenance and preventive care
- Maine contractor since 1989

## Core Services

- [Roofing & Siding Services Overview](https://www.straightlineroof.com/service): Complete overview of roofing and siding services offered throughout Central and Southern Maine
- [Roof Installation](https://www.straightlineroof.com/roofing-installation): Professional asphalt shingle and metal roof installation services in Auburn and surrounding areas
- [Roof Repair](https://www.straightlineroof.com/roof-repair): Expert roof repair services by licensed contractors in Turner, ME
- [Siding Installation](https://www.straightlineroof.com/siding-installation): Vinyl, cedar, engineered wood, and board-and-batten siding installation in Bangor
- [Window Installation](https://www.straightlineroof.com/windows-installation-central-southern-maine): Energy-efficient window installation with lifetime warranties throughout Central and Southern Maine
- [Door Installation & Replacement](https://www.straightlineroof.com/doors-installation-replacement): Entry, patio, storm, and Therma-Tru door installation services in Central Maine
- [Exterior Remodeling](https://www.straightlineroof.com/exterior-remodeling): Complete exterior remodeling including trim, sunrooms, and garage construction
- [Custom Deck Construction](https://www.straightlineroof.com/custom-built-decks): Custom-built decks using composite, PVC, and treated wood materials
